name: Bracer of Piercing Arrows

attunement.text: by a creature with at least 1 level in Ranger

entries: This finely tooled leather bracer is decorated with intricate carvings of fletched arrows. When worn, it gives the ranger's shots uncanny precision.

Piercing Shot (3/day). Before making a ranged weapon attack, choose a specific body part to target. On a hit, the target suffers the matching effect until the end of its next turn: eyes impose disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks and ranged attack rolls; arm or hand prevents wielding two-handed weapons and limits the target to holding one object; foot or leg halves speed; torso forces a Constitution saving throw with DC = 10 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier the next time the target attempts an action, losing its action and reactions until the start of its next turn on a failure.

Precise Aim (1/day). As a bonus action at the start of your turn, you focus your aim. Until the end of your next turn, whenever you hit a creature with a weapon attack, all allies gain advantage on attack rolls against that target.
